requirements.text: The app must modernise while ensuring compliance with GDPR and PSD2 regulations.
Timely notifications about transactions and balance changes need to be implemented to keep customers informed.
Control features should allow customers to adjust spending limits and access detailed spending breakdowns.
Any new features must integrate seamlessly with the existing core banking system without disrupting operations.
A thorough regulatory review must be conducted for all proposed features to mitigate potential risks.
